description: Golden files for the sync file codec (ADR-0009). Each case is a file as it would be found in the shared folder, and what a reader must do with it. Generated by a script that builds the files with Python's own json and hashlib, then the expected result is written out by hand from the ADR: the Kotlin app and the desktop app must both give exactly this for every case. Changing a case changes the format: change both apps together.

cases.name: one of everything: an account, two items (one with every field set), a correction, and a tombstone for each table
a device with nothing to say
text outside ASCII, written as raw UTF-8 (the hash is of those bytes)
the same file with every character outside ASCII escaped in the JSON
cases.note: Escaped text decodes to the same string, so the payload text, and so the hash, differ from the case above; both are fine.
